blocks.text: Flexible Payment Options for Your Engine Repair
Engine rebuilds from £2,100 – we make it affordable with no upfront deposit.
**No Deposit Required** | **Pay on Completion** | **Card / Bank Transfer** | **Finance Coming Soon**
Our Payment Options
We keep payment simple and transparent. No hidden fees, no upfront deposits, no surprises when you collect your vehicle.
**No Deposit Required**
We don't take upfront deposits. You pay only when the work is complete and you're satisfied with the result.
**Bank Transfer (BACS)**
Direct bank transfer accepted. Account details provided on your invoice. Preferred method for larger transactions.
**Debit / Credit Card**
All major cards accepted: Visa, Mastercard, American Express. Processed securely via encrypted terminal. No surcharges.
**Cash**
Cash payments accepted at our Billericay workshop. Full receipt provided immediately. Please note card limits may apply for very large amounts.
How Payment Works
Four simple steps from quote to collection. No financial commitment until you've seen and approved the completed work.
**1. Request a Quote**
Contact us with your vehicle details and symptoms. We provide a fixed-price written quote for engine rebuilding, timing chain replacement, or other repairs.
**2. Approve the Work**
You approve the quote in writing. No deposit required. We schedule your vehicle into our Billericay workshop and arrange collection if needed.
**3. We Complete the Repair**
Engine rebuild or replacement carried out by IMI-certified technicians. We keep you updated throughout with photos and progress reports.
**4. Inspect & Pay**
You inspect the completed work. If satisfied, you pay in full via your preferred method. Then you drive away with a 12-month warranty.
If you're not satisfied, we will address any issues before payment is taken. Your confidence matters more than our cash flow.
Third-Party Financing
**Monthly payment plans for engine rebuilds and replacements**
**Finance Partnerships Coming Soon**

We are currently finalising partnerships with regulated third-party finance providers to offer monthly payment plans for engine rebuilds and major repairs. This will include interest-free options over shorter terms and low-rate instalment plans over 12–60 months for larger jobs.

In the meantime: We offer no-deposit payment on completion for all work, and can discuss flexible payment arrangements on a case-by-case basis for customers facing genuine hardship. Contact us directly to discuss your situation — we're here to help, not to turn people away.
Check back soon or call 0203 488 4649 for updates on finance availability. We'll announce new partnerships here and on our social channels as soon as they're live.

Why We Don't Take Deposits
Most garages ask for 30–50% upfront before touching your vehicle. We don't. Here's why:
**You should only pay when you're happy.** An engine rebuild is a significant investment. We believe you deserve to see and verify the completed work before parting with your money.
**Trust is earned, not demanded.** This policy has built trust with thousands of customers across the UK since 2009. Our 5-star rating reflects that confidence.
**We stand behind our work.** If you're not satisfied, we don't expect payment until issues are resolved. The risk is ours, not yours.
**No financial pressure.** You approve the quote, we do the work, you pay when ready. No chasing, no awkward conversations, no leverage games.

> "Paid £3,900 for a near-new engine in my Land Rover E-Class. Dealership quoted £11,500. They didn't ask for a penny upfront — I paid when I saw the finished job and tested it myself. That's how business should be done."

Frequently Asked Questions
**Do you require a deposit?**

No. We do not take upfront deposits for any work. You pay only when the repair is complete and you are satisfied with the result. This policy applies to all services including engine rebuilds, timing chain replacements, and mechanical repairs.
**When do I need to pay?**

Payment is due on completion, before vehicle collection or delivery. You are welcome to inspect the completed work, review documentation, and test-drive (where applicable) before settling your invoice. We accept bank transfer, debit/credit card, or cash at our Billericay workshop.
**What payment methods do you accept?**

We accept bank transfer (BACS), all major debit and credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), and cash. Card payments are processed via encrypted terminal with no surcharges. For very large transactions, bank transfer is preferred. Full receipt and warranty certificate provided on completion.
**Do you offer monthly payment plans?**

We are currently finalising partnerships with regulated third-party finance providers to offer monthly payment plans. This will include interest-free and low-rate instalment options. In the meantime, we offer no-deposit payment on completion and can discuss flexible arrangements case-by-case for customers facing genuine hardship. Contact us directly to discuss your situation.
**Can I get 0% finance on my engine rebuild?**

0% finance options are planned as part of our upcoming third-party finance partnerships. These will be subject to status and lender criteria. We will announce availability here and on our social channels as soon as partnerships are live. In the interim, our no-deposit policy means you retain full control of your funds until work is verified complete.
**How do I apply for financing?**

Third-party finance applications are not yet available. When launched, applications will be completed online with decisions typically returned within minutes. We will provide direct links and guidance on this page once partnerships are confirmed. For now, contact us to discuss your requirements and explore available payment flexibility.
**Can I pay part cash and part card?**

Yes. Split payments across multiple methods are accepted. For example, you might pay a portion in cash and the remainder by card or bank transfer. Please advise us at the time of settlement so we can prepare the correct documentation and receipts for each payment method.
**Do you accept PayPal?**

PayPal is not currently accepted as a direct payment method. However, PayPal-linked debit cards (Visa/Mastercard) are accepted wherever we take card payments. As part of our upcoming finance partnerships, PayPal Credit may become available — check back for updates or contact us for current options.
**What if I'm not satisfied with the work? Do I still have to pay?**

If you identify an issue with the completed work, we will address it before payment is taken. Our no-deposit policy exists precisely to protect you in this scenario. We stand behind every job with a 12-month unlimited mileage warranty, and post-completion concerns are treated as priority. Payment is expected only once you are satisfied.
**Is there a cancellation fee if I change my mind?**

If you cancel before work begins and no parts have been ordered specifically for your vehicle, there is no cancellation fee. If bespoke parts have already been sourced or machining work has commenced, we may need to recover those costs — this will always be discussed transparently before any charge is applied. Contact us as early as possible if your circumstances change.
Ready to Get Started?

Get your fixed-price quote today — no deposit required. Whether it's an engine rebuild, timing chain replacement, or diagnostic inspection, we'll give you a transparent assessment with zero financial commitment until you're satisfied. Family-run since 2009. 12-month warranty on all work.
